reason: Our planners already know which supplier slips matter, and I would be sending open PO, job and inventory data from a startup I have never heard of to someone outside the company before IT and security have signed off. Free still means the data leaves the building, and I cannot approve that on my own.
objection: Who is this company, where does the sanitized data go, and how do I get IT and security to sign off on it inside 30 days when I am already short on time chasing suppliers.
would_change_my_mind: IT and security approve the data handling in writing (where it is stored, how long it is kept, that nothing is written back to Epicor), and the audit can run on a small sample of lines so I see a real finding before we send a full export.
